summary: This project presents a ROS2-enabled autonomous aerial drone system designed for minefield navigation and detection using multi-sensor fusion. It integrates computer vision, thermal imaging, and LiDAR-like ToF sensing with swarm coordination for safe and efficient terrain scanning.

challenge.description: The primary challenge was designing a lightweight autonomous aerial system capable of reliable mine detection and safe navigation in GPS-enabled and GPS-denied conditions. Existing systems lacked multi-sensor fusion, real-time swarm coordination, and robust fail-safe control between autonomous and manual override modes, limiting operational safety and scalability.

methodology.title: System Design & Hardware Integration
methodology.description: Designed a lightweight ABS 3D-printed drone frame optimized for thrust-to-weight ratio and vibration resistance. Integrated propulsion system (Foxeer Datura motors, Gemfan propellers), power system (Li-ion 21700 cells, UBEC), and sensor suite including GPS, ToF, thermal, and spectral sensors.

methodology.title: Embedded Systems & Autonomy Architecture
methodology.description: Implemented dual-layer architecture using ArduPilot on flight controller for stabilization and Raspberry Pi 5 for autonomy. Established MAVLink communication via MAVROS and integrated ROS2 nodes for gesture detection, mine detection, and obstacle avoidance.

methodology.title: Swarm Intelligence & Mission Execution
methodology.description: Developed ROS2-based swarm networking over Wi-Fi mesh with master election protocol for coordination. Implemented grid-based mapping, multi-sensor fusion for mine detection, and autonomous path planning with operator guidance using vision and distance sensing.

impact.label: MAX FLIGHT TIME
impact.description: Achieved extended endurance using high-density Li-ion battery configuration and efficient 4-inch bi-blade propulsion system optimized for low power draw.

impact.label: THRUST TO WEIGHT RATIO
impact.description: Maintained strong lift efficiency, enabling stable hover and payload handling for multi-sensor autonomous operations.

impact.label: SYSTEM SCALABILITY
impact.description: ROS2-based distributed architecture enables multi-drone coordination for area coverage, mapping, and cooperative mission execution.
